subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Disrupt
solution:
The correct answer is '**Breach**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate **synonym** of the given word '**Disrupt**' is '**Breach**'.
 
• **Disrupt**: to stop something happening as or when it should. [(किसी क्रिया को) विच्छिन्‍न कर देना, विघ्‍न पैदा करना, विघटन करना]
 
 
• *Example: The strike severely **disrupted** flights to New Delhi.*
 
 
 
• **Breach**: an act that breaks an agreement, a law, etc. (नियम, समझौते की शर्तों आदि का उल्‍लंघन; नियम-भंग)
 
 
• *Example: a **breach **of confidence...*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Breach.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **Arrange**: to put something in order or in a particular pattern. (व्‍यवस्थित करना, क्रम विशेष से सजाना)
 
• **Organise**: to plan or arrange an event, activity, etc. [संगठित करना (उसकी किसी कार्यक्रम, गतिविधि आदि की योजना बनाना या उसकी व्‍यवस्‍था करना)]
 
• **Injure**: to harm or hurt yourself or somebody else physically, especially in an accident. [शारीरिक चोट पहुँचाना, घायल होना या करना (विशेषतः दुर्घटना में)]
